_comment: Example input for score-sean-ellis.py. 15 responses, 6 of them 'very disappointed' — a raw 40% that PASSES the Sean Ellis line. Three of those six are polite signal (DM'd, replied within the hour, barely used the product, complimented instead of describing). Discounted, the read is 20% and the verdict flips to WEAK. This file exists to show that flip. Replace it with your own export.
